title: Bitcoin CVE-2010-5139, values that overflowed when summed
violates: No transaction creates value: the outputs sum to no more than the inputs.
because: The outputs were summed in 64-bit arithmetic without a range check, so a sum that wrapped passed the check while one output alone exceeded the input.
class: a sum that wraps because no range check comes first

cured_by.text: Check each output against a range before summing. The 2010 fix rejected outputs that overflowed and outputs above the supply limit.

also.caption: With a range check on each output the query has no witness.

minimal.why: a dated incident kept as a toy model
